_comment: AeroHost Mumble Premium — PTDL_v2 for Pterodactyl 1.15.x. Custom image must be published before use on Wings.
name: Mumble Premium — AeroHost
author: support@example.com
description: Servidor Mumble de alta calidad (Opus, bandwidth 558000) con el bot de música Bragi en el mismo contenedor. Reproduce por búsqueda y por enlace en YouTube, SoundCloud y otras plataformas vía yt-dlp. El bot responde en inglés. Los enlaces de Spotify no se reproducen de forma nativa (DRM); busca el tema con !yplay. — AeroHost

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash set -e mkdir -p /mnt/server/music /mnt/server/tmp cd /mnt/server if [ ! -f /mnt/server/murmur.ini ]; then echo "Writing default high-quality murmur.ini" cat > /mnt/server/murmur.ini << 'EOF' ; AeroHost Mumble Premium — murmur/mumble-server configuration ; Panel variables (port, users, bandwidth, server password) are applied on every start. ; Do not put the SuperUser password in this file; it is set with mumble-server -supw. database=/home/container/murmur.sqlite logfile=/home/container/murmur.log pidfile=/home/container/murmur.pid welcometext="
Welcome to AeroHost Mumble Premium — high-quality Opus voice plus a music bot.
Music commands (English): !yplay <search>, !ysearch <query>, !url or !play <YouTube / SoundCloud / other link>, !volume 0-100, !skip, !stop, !queue, !help.
Spotify links are not streamed natively (DRM). Search the track with !yplay instead.
" port=64738 host=0.0.0.0 serverpassword= bandwidth=558000 users=40 ; 0 = always use Opus (preferred). 558000 bit/s is the official Mumble maximum/default. opusthreshold=0 ; Ice is unused in this egg and is left disabled on purpose. icesecretwrite= EOF else echo "murmur.ini already exists, leaving it in place." fi if [ ! -f /mnt/server/COMMANDS.txt ]; then cat > /mnt/server/COMMANDS.txt << 'EOF' AeroHost Mumble Premium — music bot commands (English) The bot replies in English. Prefix: ! !yplay Search YouTube and play the first result !ysearch Search YouTube and pick from a short list !url Play a YouTube, SoundCloud, or other yt-dlp URL !play Play a URL or a local file !volume 0-100 Set volume !pause / !stop Pause or stop !skip Skip the current track !queue Show the playlist !radio Play a configured radio station !rbquery Search radio-browser.info !help Full command list Spotify: links are not streamed natively (no official stream / DRM). Use !yplay with the track and artist name instead. If YouTube searches fail from a datacenter IP, place a Netscape-format cookie file at youtube-cookies.txt in this folder and restart the server. EOF fi echo "AeroHost Mumble Premium install files are ready." echo "done"

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Port Mumble binds to (TCP and UDP). Must match the server allocation. The music bot connects to 127.0.0.1 on this port.

variables.name: Maximum Users
variables.description: Maximum concurrent clients, including the music bot. 40 is a sensible default for a high-quality voice + music server.

variables.name: Bandwidth
variables.description: Maximum client bandwidth in bits per second. 558000 is the official Mumble maximum and the high-quality default. Do not set higher; the server will cap it.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for an open server. Never stored in the egg defaults.

variables.name: SuperUser Password
variables.description: Password for the Mumble SuperUser account. Set on every start via mumble-server -supw. Choose at least 8 characters. Never leave this as a hardcoded default.

variables.name: Bot Name
variables.description: Display name of the music bot on the Mumble server.

variables.name: Bot Default Volume
variables.description: Default music bot volume from 1 to 100. Used when the bot starts (unless a previous volume was saved in its database).

variables.name: Bot Channel
variables.description: Channel the music bot should join. Leave empty to stay in Root. Create the channel in Mumble first if you set a name here (for example Music).
